column3: NKJV adds the headings “THE BELOVED” and “(TO HIS FRIENDS)”; “become drunk, O lovers” is rendered “drink deeply, O beloved ones.”
NKJV adds a heading and supplies “saying”; “filled with dew” is rendered “covered with dew.”
Close to the Hebrew; “tunic” is rendered “robe,” and “dirty” “defile.”
NKJV renders “from the hole” as “By the latch of the door,” and “my inward parts were stirred” as “my heart yearned.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my soul went out when he spoke” is rendered “My heart leaped up when he spoke.”
Close to the Hebrew; רְדִידִי (“shawl”) is rendered “my veil.”
Close to the Hebrew; “what will you tell him? that I am sick of love” is rendered “That you tell him I am lovesick!”
NKJV adds a heading for the daughters of Jerusalem; “adjured” is rendered “charge.”
NKJV adds a heading; “dazzling” is rendered “white,” and “conspicuous” “Chief.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sitting on fullness” is rendered “fitly set.”
Close to the Hebrew; “towers of herbs” is rendered “Banks of scented herbs.”
Close to the Hebrew; בַּתַּרְשִׁישׁ (“Tarshish stone”) is rendered “with beryl,” and “his belly” “His body.”
Close to the Hebrew; “chosen” is rendered “Excellent.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plurals “sweetnesses… desirablenesses” are rendered “most sweet… altogether lovely.”
